cases.summary: Authorised user opens New POS from the dashboard
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Dealer, Supervisor, Team Leader, or Reseller
cases.input: 1. Select New POS from the dashboard.
cases.expected: New POS / new touchpoint flow starts. Staging PDV is not in the profile list; do not use that account for this case.
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-001; Main Flow step 1 / Applicability

cases.summary: Touchpoint type is mandatory; all listed types; no profile restriction
cases.input: 1. Attempt submit with no type. 2. Select POA, POS Airtime, POS Mixte, Dealer Shop.
cases.expected: Selection is mandatory. Available values: POA, POS Airtime, POS Mixte, Dealer Shop. All profiles can report any type. No profile-based restrictions.
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-017; Touchpoint Types

cases.summary: Owner first name, last name, and MSISDN are mandatory
cases.input: 1. Leave each owner field empty in turn and attempt submit.
cases.expected: Owner First Name, Last Name, MSISDN are all mandatory. User cannot submit without completing owner information.

cases.summary: Address flow requires Address/Landmark, District, City
cases.input: 1. Leave each required address field empty. 2. Complete them.
cases.expected: Address / Landmark, District, and City are required before Validate is enabled.
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-005, REQ-011; Option 1: Enter Address / Address Flow

cases.summary: District and city typing shows existing suggestions
cases.input: 1. Start typing a known district. 2. Start typing a known city. 3. Select from the list.
cases.expected: Existing districts and cities are suggested. User selects from available values.

cases.summary: Map flow opens, allows any location, search suggests matches, close icon cancels
cases.input: 1. Open map. 2. Move and select a location. 3. Use search bar. 4. Cancel with top-right close.
cases.expected: Map opens. User can move anywhere, select any location, search locations. Matching locations are suggested. Validate selected location or cancel via close icon.
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009; Option 2: Select on Map

cases.summary: No zoning, territory, or distance restriction blocks submission
cases.preconditions: Location outside assigned territory, district, and zone
cases.input: 1. Submit a touchpoint outside assigned territory, district, and zone.
cases.expected: Request is allowed. No geographical validation should block submission.
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-010; Zoning Rules — No Restrictions

cases.summary: Map Validate is enabled once a location is selected
cases.expected: Validate button is enabled. User submits the request. Create Dealer API is used (observable by success, not by payload invention).
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-012, REQ-013; Map Flow / Submission

cases.summary: Successful submission notifies SN System, SFA, and RSS for the district
cases.input: 1. Submit. 2. Check SN System ticket, SFA share, RSS notification for the selected district.
cases.expected: New touchpoint ticket in SN System. Information shared with SFA. RSS responsible for the selected district is notified. No impact on stock, commission, or performance.
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-014, REQ-015; Notifications / Post Conditions

cases.summary: Owner MSISDN from the inventory comment can be used without copying secrets into Excel
cases.preconditions: Authorised account; owner MSISDN from EnvConfig inventory (comment 2026-09-20 listed test numbers)
cases.input: 1. Enter owner MSISDN from EnvConfig, not from this workbook.
cases.expected: Form accepts a staging owner MSISDN. Parent MSISDN asked in comment 2026-09-21 was not answered — do not invent a parent.
cases.traceability: SAA-945; REQ-004, REQ-016; comment test numbers

cases.summary: Figma screenshot was not readable from this session
cases.input: 1. Do not design extra screens from the unread PNG.
cases.expected: Attachment image-20251008-100814.png bytes were not accessible. No extra UI is assumed.
